title: fix(app-shell): Studio's nav rail draws a separator as a divider and a leaf's badge as the sidebar does (objectui#11791)
body:
Fixes #11791

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

Studio's Interfaces rail (`NavTree` in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) now draws a `separator` entry as a divider, and a leaf's `badge` / `badgeVariant` as a pill, with the decisions the running app's sidebar makes.

- **Separator.** `NavTree` had a group branch and a leaf branch only. A separator fell into the leaf branch, where `resolveSurface` answers `null`, and drew as a disabled button with no name and the generic glyph. It now has its own branch, checked first, as the sidebar checks it: a decorative `Separator` (`role="none"`). It is no button, no tab stop, and nothing a screen reader announces.
- **Badge.** A leaf with a present `badge` (`!= null`, so a count `0` too) draws a `Badge` after its label with `variant={badgeVariant}`; an absent variant is `Badge`'s own default, which is the sidebar's. It is drawn on every leaf row, a disabled one included, and on no group heading, as in the sidebar.
- `NavNode` (`navSurface.ts`) declares `badge` / `badgeVariant`, typed from the spec's `ObjectNavItem` as `filters` / `viewName` already are, so the rail reads them without a cast. The module header's sentence that a separator renders as a disabled leaf, which this change made false, is corrected. `resolveSurface` is untouched: the divider does not need it.

## The reference it mirrors

The console's running app sidebar is `UnifiedSidebar`, which mounts `NavigationRenderer` from `@object-ui/layout` (`packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx`). Its decisions, read on `5aa7f55`:

- separator: the `item.type === 'separator'` branch returns a `Separator` (`my-2`) inside an `aria-hidden` list item, "a rule, not an entry: its item is hidden from assistive tech" (objectui#11690);
- badge: `item.badge != null` draws `Badge` with `variant={item.badgeVariant ?? 'default'}` on action and leaf rows; the group branch draws none.

No shared piece exists to import: the sidebar draws both inline in its row renderer, whose rows are `SidebarMenu` items this rail does not use. The rail imports the same two primitives (`Badge` and `Separator` from `@object-ui/components`, already an app-shell dependency, so no package dependency is added) and mirrors the decision. The pin `StudioDesignSurface.railSeparatorBadge-11791.test.tsx` renders BOTH surfaces from one spec-valid fixture and compares them: the number of rules, their element and role; each badge's text and variant, the variant classified from `badgeVariants` itself. A change to the sidebar's decision turns this pin red, and its describe names the sidebar file.

## PM hypotheses, measured

- **H1, confirmed.** On `5aa7f55`, `NavTree` branched on `node.type === 'group'` or non-empty `children`, and otherwise rendered a leaf button with `disabled={!surface}`. The type is read from `node.type` (`NavNode.type`), unchanged by objectui#11790.
- **H2, confirmed.** Reference named above; mirrored with a pin, not imported.
- **H3, half confirmed.** The rule is not selectable and not focusable, and keyboard navigation skips it. The screen-reader half is not taken as written: the sidebar's decision is a decorative rule hidden from assistive tech, not `role="separator"` or an `hr`. The rail does the same and announces nothing; the pin asserts no `separator` role on either surface.

## File surface

Within the files of claim `6050663041`:

- `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: `NavTree`, plus two names (`Badge`, `Separator`) added to its `@object-ui/components` import list, which sits outside the `NavTree` range;
- `navSurface.ts`: the `NavNode` interface and the module header, not `resolveSurface`;
- the new test `StudioDesignSurface.railSeparatorBadge-11791.test.tsx`;
- `.changeset/11791-rail-separator-badge.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch).

Nothing on the claim's "Not on it" list is touched: not the nav item inspector or its separator hint, not `studio-canvas-preview.tsx`, not the autosave or publish path, not the runtime sidebar's files, not `packages/components/src/ui/**` or `packages/i18n/**`. No string is added.

## Verification

The i18n gates were not run: no string is added. The full `pnpm test` and lint farm are CI's.

**Reverse verification** (at `d95885e`, the fix committed first). `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` was checked out from base `5aa7f55` with the pin at HEAD: the marker `objectui#11791` went from 3 hits to 0, and the file's hash equalled the base blob. The pin ran 4 failed, 3 passed: red were the rule test ("expected [] to have a length of 2"), the unlabeled-row test ("Expected element not to have accessible name"), the rule-not-selectable test and the badge test ("expected [ null, null, null, null ]"). Green were the two fixture checks and the no-badge control, as they should be. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --` under an exit trap; the file's hash equalled the HEAD blob and `git diff HEAD` was empty.

## Acceptance notes

- The `nav:menu` page block (`packages/app-shell/src/views/nav-menu-renderer.tsx`) draws an entry's badge with `badgeVariant ?? 'secondary'` and skips a `badge` of `''`. The sidebar's absent variant is `default`, and it draws any non-null badge. This was read in source only and not reproduced at a public door, so it is noted here and not filed. Carrier: none.
